page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note at the right beside the line "maxima DAMMONA est". Running head at top centre-left with the page number at top right. Catchword at the lower right, signature "B" at the lower left.

main_text.p: septentrionibus alluit, quâ Amasus, quâ Dullartus se sinuant, in orâ aggeribus perpetuis, opere difficillimo, sepitur & defenditur contra aquarum influxum: idemque, ut dixi jam ante, secundùm Hunesi lapsum fit non ab urbe solùm, sed & supra urbem, usque ad ejusdem ostium. In eâ post Groningam nobilissima & maxima DAMMONA est, DAMMONA.non vilis oppidi instar, si ambitum, & frequentiam ha-bitatorum, si ædificiorum numerum, magnitudinem, formam, si viarum habitum spectes, sed honore mœnium, & jure imperii civilis magistratuumque carens, amœna, in circulum ferè se colli-gens, fosaque ut plurimùm cingens, templo illustri cum turre latè spectabili insig-nis; fanum quoque monasticum peram-plum, sed extra ambitum, lateri tamen occiduo penè contiguum habens familiæ Augustinianæ, nunc ab omni cultu de-fertum, ac vix se sustinens: sita ad Fi-velam amnem duobus infra Groningam milliaribus cæciam versùs, eodemque amne navigabili media divisa, pontibus intus connexa quinque; unde ad exitum amnis,

page.notes: The page number "17" at the top right is partly smudged; the reading is doubtful. The long s is transcribed as a plain s throughout, so "fi"-looking letters in "si", "sed" and "sita" are read as s. The printed note in the right margin is set in spaced capitals. The stray marks at the left and right edges are scan artefacts and have been left out. The text at the foot of the scan is a digitiser's watermark and has been left out.
